name: Sei Faery Gakuen Joshi Ryou
original_name: 聖フェアリー学園女子寮
source:
This is the elite girl school for higher class society. There are plans to liberalize the school, but upper class led by principal daughter oppose the idea. Main character needs to infiltrate the school, get past the guards and to the top floor where the school principal daughter resides.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一所面向上流社会的女子精英学校。学校计划开放招生，但由校长女儿领导的上层阶级反对这一想法。主人公必须潜入学校，突破守卫，抵达校长女儿所在的顶层。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
